objects.basis: 1 nm accommodates all integer source coordinates; inherited W003 toy choice, not inferred by GCD; no PDK/PCell/production default

objects.encoding: GDS base16 REAL8 round-nearest ties-to-even 56-bit mantissa
objects.equivalence: Both UNITS fields bind independently to the sole nominal candidate with exact normal exponent and absolute error <= REAL8_ULP/2. KLayout-generated expected GDS has UNITS-only nearest56 normalization with explicit provenance; XY never changed.
objects.output_nominal_selection: source nominal tick is fixed at 1 nm; output policy may select any positive rational nominal tick exactly encodable to nearest56 units, but every source-coordinate/output-tick ratio must be an integer in signed 32-bit range; source and output scale bindings are separate
